options.name: commands
options.description: Commands: { id, label, keywords?, group?, description?, shortcut?, icon?, children?, disabled?, run? }.

options.name: providers
options.description: Async searches ({ id, label, search(query, { signal }), minQueryLength? }), listed after the commands.

options.name: recent
options.description: Command ids shown in the Recent section while the query is empty.

options.name: recentLimit
options.description: Most recent commands remembered (0 hides the section).

options.name: icons
options.description: Search, loading, back, and submenu icons.

options.name: shortcut
options.description: Hotkey that opens and closes the palette (matchesHotkey syntax; Mod is Cmd on Apple platforms, Ctrl elsewhere); null for none.

options.name: debounce
options.description: Milliseconds between the last keystroke and provider searches (0 to 2000).

options.name: overscan
options.description: Rows rendered beyond each edge of the visible area.

properties.name: recent
properties.description: Recent command ids, most recent first.

properties.name: path
properties.description: Ids of the open nested pages.

methods.name: open
methods.signature: open(options?: { page?: string; query?: string }): void
methods.description: Open, optionally on a command's nested page and with a query.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Replace the search text and search.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Close, remove the dialog and the shortcut listener, abort searches.

events.name: aui-select
events.description: A command was chosen: { id, command, path, query, providerId }; preventDefault() skips command.run. The palette closes first.

cssClasses.name: aui-command-palette__search | __search-icon | __input | __spinner
cssClasses.description: Search row, icon, field, and loading indicator.

cssClasses.name: aui-command-palette__crumbs | __back | __trail
cssClasses.description: Nested page trail and back button.

cssClasses.name: aui-command-palette__list | __canvas
cssClasses.description: Result listbox and its positioning layer.

cssClasses.name: aui-command-palette__option | __option--active
cssClasses.description: A result (role=option) and the active one.

cssClasses.name: aui-command-palette__empty | __error | __footer | __hint | __status
cssClasses.description: Empty State host, provider error, key hints, and the live status.
